objects.name: agency
objects.description: The organization this mount serves, of which there is one.

objects.name: draft
objects.description: An editable copy of the organization, which is the only thing anybody edits.

objects.name: goal
objects.description: Something the organization is trying to achieve.

objects.name: objective
objects.description: One granular thing under a goal, and the unit a seat is answerable for.

objects.name: risk
objects.description: Something that could go wrong for the organization, named by the event at its centre.

objects.name: risk_pathway
objects.description: One way a risk comes about, or one consequence it leads to.

objects.name: hazard
objects.description: Something that could cause harm, kept once and named by any number of risks.

objects.name: threat
objects.description: A way a top event can come about, kept once and used by any number of risks.

objects.name: consequence
objects.description: What follows a top event, kept once and used by any number of risks.

objects.name: risk_threat
objects.description: A risk's use of a library threat.

objects.name: risk_consequence
objects.description: A risk's use of a library consequence.

objects.name: workflow
objects.description: A named sequence of work the organization performs.

objects.name: work_item
objects.description: One step of a workflow, with the instruction it is performed from.

objects.name: event_flow_step
objects.description: One step of a workflow's event flow, from trigger to handler.

objects.name: role
objects.description: A seat somebody or something holds in this organization.

objects.name: role_assignment
objects.description: One RACI label: which seat takes part in which step, and how.

objects.name: workflow_objective
objects.description: One link saying a workflow delivers an objective.

objects.name: module
objects.description: One capability from the platform catalog, switched on or off.

objects.name: value
objects.description: Something this organization believes, written down to be read.

objects.name: value_attachment
objects.description: One place a belief of this organization applies.

objects.name: rule
objects.description: Something this organization requires or forbids.

objects.name: rule_attachment
objects.description: One place a requirement of this organization applies.

objects.name: control
objects.description: What the agency commits to, advisory or enforced.

objects.name: control_attachment
objects.description: One place a control stands.

objects.name: issue
objects.description: Something the validation scan found wrong in a draft.

objects.name: agency_publication
objects.description: A frozen copy of this organization, and what production runs from.

objects.name: code_sequence
objects.description: The counter behind each kind of stable handle.

objects.name: measure
objects.description: One figure an objective is judged by, with its target.

objects.name: record
objects.description: A named list a workflow keeps beside its steps.

objects.name: record_row
objects.description: One row added to a record from the member app.

objects.name: scenario
objects.description: A path through one workflow that the Test agent plays out.

objects.name: scenario_actor
objects.description: Someone the Test agent plays in one scenario.

objects.name: scenario_input
objects.description: A value fixed for one field of one step in one scenario.

objects.name: test_run
objects.description: One run of one scenario, kept with what transpired in it.

objects.name: review
objects.description: One run of the AI reviewers over one draft.

objects.name: review_area
objects.description: One reviewer's part of a review.

objects.name: review_finding
objects.description: One suggestion a reviewer made, with what the designer did with it.

objects.name: review_comment
objects.description: The designer's note on a finding.
